Over the past few weeks, we hosted special birthday parties together with our community partners: Ronald McDonald House Charities Singapore (@rmhcsingapore), the Ministry of Social and Family Development (@msfcares) and Families For Life (@familiesforlife) ❤️

Held across our restaurants at Yio Chu Kang Sports Complex, Choa Chu Kang Park and Queensway (Ridout Tea Garden), we celebrated over 100 children and parents with plenty of smiles, games and birthday fun! 🎂✨

We were happy to have Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (@samdingoingon), Grassroots Adviser to Ang Mo Kio GRC GROs, and Ms Chua Wei-Shan (@weishan.chua), Second Grassroots Adviser to Chua Chu Kang GRC GROs, join in the celebrations.

A lovely reminder of what it means to come together as one community. Here's to creating more memories together! ❤️

#mcdsg #McDCARES #FamiliesforLife

What would you tell your younger self?

partnering with @mcdsg this World Mental Health Day to talk about a little kindness ❤️

some people knew straight away. some had to sit with it. but all of them said something I think their younger self needed to hear and probably something they still need to hear now.

happy World Mental Health Day, fam. be soft with yourself today, and with whoever is sitting next to you (and i will take my own advice) 

if you could sit across from your younger self today, what is one thing you’d want them to know?

drop your thoughts below, or take a moment today to give yourself the love you deserve.

thank you @mcdsg for letting me bring “Lovin’ Me” back out into the world for this one. In support of World Mental Health Day 2026.

#lovinme #wmhd2026 #mcdsg
